Planning a visit to South Korea?

Agha Travel & Tours helps Pakistani applicants navigate the short-term visit visa process with practical guidance, accurate application preparation and documentation tailored to the purpose of travel.

Visa at a Glance

C-3-9 is the general tourist category, with a possible stay of up to 90 days subject to the actual visa issued. Other short-term categories may apply to family or business travel.

Short-Term Visit VisaSouth Korea · from Pakistan

What You Should Know

The essentials of the South Korea Short-Term Visit Visa, before you start your file.

01

Who This Visa Is For

Choose the category matching your genuine purpose. A tourist itinerary is different from a visit sponsored by a Korean resident or a business trip to a Korean company.

02

Important Country-Specific Guidance

For family or business cases, invitation and guarantee documents may be required, in some circumstances as original or notarized copies. Check the category-specific checklist rather than assuming a simple invitation is sufficient.

03

A Personalised Application, Not a Generic Checklist

Each application is assessed against the traveller’s actual circumstances. Our team helps you present relevant information clearly and consistently, rather than adding unnecessary paperwork or repeating documents that do not support your case.

Checklist

Documents You Should Prepare

A starting point for your South Korea file. Our consultants tailor the final checklist to your travel purpose and profile.

Get My Checklist

Core documents

  • Valid Passport
  • CNIC, FRC and MRC (if married).
  • Last 6 months Bank statement.
  • Business or Employment details.

When visiting relatives, friends or for business

  • Host invitation
  • Proof of relationship
  • Your host’s status in South Korea

Documents requested by the Korean mission may differ by category.

South Korea Visa Application

Practical steps, professional support and clear next actions.

01

How We Help You Apply

We review the visa category, document consistency, financial evidence, Korean host documents and travel plans before submission.

02

Application & Submission Process

The Korean authorities may request original documents, further verification or additional information. Processing times and applicable fees depend on the visa route and mission instructions.

03

Before You Make Travel Plans

The visa granted determines the allowed duration and entries. Approval rests with Korean immigration or consular authorities.
